additionalItems validation produces incorrect index values and error messages

#### Description

When validating arrays with `additionalItems`, the validation logic is producing incorrect index values during enumeration and generating confusing error messages. The issue affects both the indexing used when validating additional items against a schema object and the error reporting when additional items are not allowed.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
    "type": "array",

data = ["hello", 42, True, False]
```

```python
errors = list(validator.iter_errors(data_with_extra))

```
